categoryDescriptions.scheduling: Booking, moving, or cancelling an appointment; asking when appointments are available or how long a visit takes.
categoryDescriptions.billing: Charges, invoices, payments, payment plans, and what a procedure costs with or without insurance.
categoryDescriptions.insurance: Which insurance plans are accepted, what a plan covers, and what to bring so benefits can be verified.
categoryDescriptions.clinical-question: Anything about symptoms, pain, injury, a procedure, or aftercare - including asking whether something needs to be seen. A message that describes a symptom is a clinical question even when it also asks about coming in.
categoryDescriptions.other: Anything that fits none of the above: office logistics such as parking or directions, records requests, vendors, job applicants, general questions.
